comment: Professor Feldman is easily my favorite professor at UR, and I loved his class. You will definitely learn a lot if you pay attention and there is a lot to gain from each one of his classes.

Feldman is prob the best but hardest 201 professor. You learn a lot from him, but its true the class is semi-difficult. If you want an easy grade, take another prof but Feldman really cares about his students and tries his best to help them do well.

He used to be an accountant so a really great teacher if you are genuinely interested in accounting. However, his tests are hard, and worth 76% if your grade... I also hate cold calling. Every class is spent slightly on edge because he might call on you at any second and ask a question, he also isn't the nicest when you don't know the answer.

Best professor ever. Super down-to-earth and makes the material fun to learn. He uses a reverse classroom style, which works very well. Roughly 75% of the overall grade is tests and exams, but he gives you the problem types beforehand. No surprises. 

Genuinely can't say enough nice things about him. If you can take him, do it.
Great lectures, decent amount of hw. Tough tests. Fun guy, I would def take him again.

Feldman is a great professor because he is personable and shares loads of anecdotes from his notable career in corporate accounting. With that said, he is pretty old school. He cold calls for hw, most of your grade comes from exams, and he likes things done in specific ways.

Professor Feldman is the best professor I've had. He truly cares for his students, and his love and knowledge of accounting is evident. I go to class confused, and come out feeling confident in the material because he explains it thoroughly with good examples. The content is difficult but he makes it as enjoyable as possible.
Greatest to ever do it

Professor Feldman truly loves accounting and it shows in his teaching. I appreciate his enthusiasm as financial accounting isn't exactly riveting. He makes the content accessible and gives super helpful methods to approach certain skills. However, the tests are hard. I found myself crunched for time on them and you're mostly graded on those 3 tests

Prof. Feldman is an AMAZING professor, he's clear, understandable, & great at explaining the basics of accounting in a way that makes sense if you have no experience with the subject. His exams are difficult but fair. He cold calls during class, make sure you do & understand all of the homework. He's so kind & funny which makes the class engaging.

Professor Feldman is a talented professor who makes accounting very engaging. Draws on a lot of real world experience and is contagiously passionate about accounting. He is willing to help and makes doing well attainable if you put the work in. Outstanding professor, definitely take him for 201.
My favorite profesor here. I would definitely take him for accounting 201. He explains things really well and is funny.

Professor Feldman is the BEST professor you could take for accounting 201. As someone with zero accounting experience prior to this class professor Feldman explained everything so clearly that it was fairly easy to understand. Homework is mandatory and he cold calls for answers every class. Exams are very fair and the lectures are super engaging.
He is a good experienced teacher to teach you real world acct. Take him if you want to be great in acct.
He is my favorite teach I have ever had at UR! I am bad at accounting and if I tried more in his class I easily could have gotten a better grade. I 100% recommend any class he teaches.

Feldman is the best. It's obvious that he's very knowledgeable about accounting, and cares a lot about his students. You have to read before every class, and do practice problems in order to be successful. However, if you do what he tells you to do, it's not hard to get an A. Grading is based on many things, but primarily three tests and a final.
Feldman is the best professor I have ever had. After his class I'm inspired to be add an accounting concentration. Take him!!!!
Best teacher Ive ever had. Take this dude, end of story

Accounting is hard no matter who you take it with, but professor Feldman is a great guy and a great professor. He is friendly in and out of class, and loves the subject. He wants you to do well, but the grade is dependent on a few assignments that are difficult.

Professor Feldman is an amazing professor. His class is hard and will definitely challenge you, but you will learn. He makes sure everyone learns and understands concepts fully. A challenge but also one of the best professors I have ever had.

Legit the best teacher I've ever had and he cares so much about his students. If you're confused about the hw, by the end of class you'll completely understand the chapter. He handwrites his own notes, is always available for extra help, and just breaks things down easily. He gives lectures but they aren't boring bc he's hilarious. Take him!!!

Professor Feldman is clear in his expectations, GENEROUS with help, and overall a KIND and ACCOMMODATING professor! I have not had an instructor CARE and WORK WITH ME as much as he has. Exams are hard but he gives us everything. I guarantee, if you put the work in you will actually learn the material, not just memorize it like other classes!!!!!!!!

Feldman is AWESOME! Best 201 prof. Tests are complicated & the class is challenging, particularly if you don't like accounting and are trying to declare another major in Bschool. But Feldman breaks the course down into manageable pieces and gives real-world examples for why we need to make these journal entries. If you're on the fence, take him!

Professor Feldman is a great teacher who makes the textbook and subject easier to understand. However, take another teacher if you want a good grade. The tests are weighted too heavily in the grade compared to the work expected in this course and he is a tough grader. The second half of the semester was too fast because he crammed extra material in

Feldman is by far the best professor at UR! This class is hard (content-wise), but he is always accessible outside of class through zoom or in person. He is amazing at explaining information to students. I don't particularly enjoy accounting, but this was my favorite class at UR. If you have the chance to take a class with Feldman, DO IT!!!!!!

He is one of the best professors I have ever met at UR. He cares for students and provides reasonable homework, quiz, and exams. If you want to major in accounting, his class is a great start. If you don't want to major in accounting but want a business major, take his class. You will never regret taking his class!!!
Amazing professor. Made me switch into the business school! Gives real world context for accounting and makes the material engaging. Definitely take him for accounting 201.

S-Tier accounting prof for 201. If you're an accounting student, Feldman is beautiful for learning the material with no easy way out (tests were open response questions but very straightforward in terms of what's taught in class). He taught us work-life lessons which he's gained from being the VP/Controller of Altria. Take the Juul King

I don't understand the negative reviews about Professor Feldman - he was easily the best bschool professor I've had in my experience at the university so far. Very friendly, makes things very clear in class. His tests aren't too hard and he gives partial credit on answers. He also has a lot of experience and you can tell he wants students to learn
Could have been the worst professor I have ever had. Do not take his class, not a good person either.

there is a lack of empathy; feels like he forgets what it is like to be a student. He is a good explainer, but doesn't understand that his students are overwhelmed. If you don't know an answer in class then you get docked on participation. Accounting is his life and if you don't make yours good luck charlie
Professor Feldman is a great professor that has a very clear outline to class. He does a great job of making accountable manageable, and he simplifies everything nicely.
Feldman is goated. You will actually learn the material really well. He keeps it simple and that really helps on getting to understand the material. He's the best for ACCT 201 no question.
Great teacher hard grader

He really knows his stuff, and all of his expectations are fair. I legitimately enjoyed him both as a professor and a person, which is rare to find. He is clear and precise, and no question is too little or stupid.

Feldman is the absolute GOAT. Best teacher I have had here at UR. The class requires some work but you will really learn Accounting. He is very knowledgeable and just a great guy in general. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking to take financial accounting.

Feldman is INCREDIBLE! He was VP & CONTROLLER of Altria ($71.9B company: 169 on Fortune 500), so the idea that you can talk to him & get good feedback is something most students DON'T GET! There were 10 quizzes (drops 2), 3 exams (review session before each), & hw (not graded). He is very accessible. Reference from him could be start of your career
Great professor
Always makes his lectures fun and accesible. Offers you class notes which help so much with understanding the materials.

Best teacher at UR and he isn't even a full time teacher. He is hilarious, personable, and makes accounting incredibly easy to learn. If you have the chance to get into his only class, you won't regret it.

Professor Feldman is truly an awesome professor. Feldman gives several opportunities to lift your grade and he truly just wants everyone to pass and understand the work. He is very accessible outside of class and will never hesitate to meet with you if you're having trouble. He also hosts review sessions for every test which he assigns.

Professor Feldman is a hilarious person. His lecture is really engaging and he often brings guest speakers to talk about the business world. He often gives real life examples which are pretty interesting. His class is not that hard.

One of the greatest professors/teachers I've had. Very personable and will make sure YOU understand the material. Goes over conceptual material and ties it in to real world examples. Also teaches you life lessons along the way. VP controller of Altria so he knows what he's doing. Highly recommend taking his course. Does not grade homework.

Professor Feldman is the one to take for accounting! He is genuinely such a nice guy and really cares about his student; always making sure we understand the subject. Accounting is definitely not easy, but I don't think I learned so much in a class before. He is very experienced in this field and gives real-life insights on the accounting world

Professor Feldman is the best professor I've had in the Bschool so far! Very caring guy who loves his work and is always willing to go the extra mile to help you learn the material. I'm not big on accounting, but he's really made me enjoy the course this semester!

Professor Feldman is one of the nicest and most caring professors I've had here. Even though I don't like accounting, he always worked really hard to make classes clear and engaging. His quizzes are easy if you study and pay attention in class. Do the homework and you'll get an A. Overall, wonderful guy and very passionate about his job!

Professor Feldman is amazing.  He brings in different outside speakers from Altria, his place of work.  Although it is a night class, it is probably the most rewarding intro to accounting class the school offers.
